# PROCESS — cand_0002 (iteration 2)

## Ranked clusters (this iteration's trajectories of cand_0001)
| rank | cluster | tasks / trials | root cause | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | K. Invented flight numbers in cabin-only upgrades | 44 t0,t3,t4 (HAT001/HAT002, HAT101/HAT202, HAT401, HAT003/004/005); 23 t1 (flight change on basic economy) | agent fills `flights` with docstring-example or made-up numbers; env accepts any existing flight, so the DB is corrupted | BEHAVIORAL / RULE | in-body guards in update_reservation_flights + calculate_flight_change_cost (basic-economy flights locked; new flights must exist on the reservation route; itinerary must start at origin); remove ALL copyable HATxxx examples from docstrings |
| 2 | L. Incomplete itinerary booked | 23 t3 (round trip HAT023 + HAT100, SFO→SEA leg missing) | agent drops one leg of a one-stop | RULE | route-continuity guard in book_reservation |
| 3 | M. Certificate partially used, remainder on card | 20 t4 (cert $155 of $250 + $100 card; gold $250 + $5) | agent splits by hand | RULE | normalization in book_reservation: fill the certificate up to its balance before the credit card/gift cards (policy: leftover certificate balance is lost) |
| 4 | N. Cancel output misread as a bad new booking → transfer | 23 t2 | raw cancelled reservation (old basic-economy cabin) looked like "booked wrong" | CAPABILITY (return value) | enriched return of cancel_reservation (explicit SUCCESS text + refunds + old reservation) |
| 5 | O. Reservation misidentification | 35 t4 (said M20IZO is MCO→SEA, missed the JFK→MCO trip); 42 t0 (over-cancelled MFRB94), 42 t2 (misread routes → transfer) | agent juggles 4–7 raw reservation JSONs | CAPABILITY-GAP (loop) | get_user_details returns `reservations_overview` (one line per reservation: route, every flight + date, passengers, cabin, insurance, booked) |
| 6 | P. Refused legit split / wrong booking order / asks holder dob | 23 t1 (refused split), 23 t4 (all 3 correct bookings but Liam booked first → reservation ids differ from gold → DB mismatch), 35 t4 (asked dob → user out-of-scope) | knowledge | KNOWLEDGE | book_reservation docstring: split allowed even on one account + worked example; book in the order the user listed (holder first); never ask the holder's or saved passengers' dob |
| 7 | J'. total_baggages = free allowance | 8 t4 ("no additional baggage" → 2) | knowledge | KNOWLEDGE | param doc with the exact phrase + worked example |
| 8 | Q. "flights longer than N h" vs journey total | 44 (gold upgrades KC18K6: legs 3h+2h, 7h incl. layover) | interpretation | KNOWLEDGE | get_reservation_flight_times doc: show per-flight AND total; layover is not flight time |
| — | X. Cross-session contamination | 10 t0 (task 23's cancel K1NW8N / book calls executed inside task 10's env) | framework (proxy routes tool calls to wrong session) | n/a | not fixable in tools → FRAMEWORK_IMPROVEMENTS.md |

## Edits (all kept edits)
| id | file | type | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | update_reservation_flights.py | guard: basic_economy + flight list ≠ current → Error listing current flights | BOUNDED: fires only when the flights of a basic-economy reservation would change; policy forbids that. All 20 gold calls pass (incl. 32 where cabin is upgraded first, then flights changed) |
| E2 | update_reservation_flights.py | guard: each NEW flight must be found by direct/one-stop search on the reservation's origin↔destination on that date (and previous day for 2nd legs); first flight must depart from origin | BOUNDED: invented / off-route flights only; 20/20 gold pass |
| E3 | calculate_flight_change_cost.py | same basic-economy guard; placeholder example | BOUNDED, read-only tool |
| E4 | book_reservation.py | route guard (first leg from origin, continuity, one_way ends at destination, round_trip reaches destination and returns to origin); only when every leg's route is found | BOUNDED; 10/10 gold books pass unaltered |
| E5 | book_reservation.py | certificate fill-up normalization (moves money from credit card first, then gift cards, onto the certificate up to its balance; notes tell the agent the final split) | BOUNDED: fires only when a certificate is under-used AND another method pays; every gold booking already uses certificates up to min(balance, price) → no gold altered |
| E6 | book_reservation.py docs | split allowed + example, order rule, dob-from-profile, total_baggages phrase, no copyable flight ids | additive knowledge |
| E7 | cancel_reservation.py | enriched success return `{result, refunds, cancelled_reservation}` | no DB effect; eligibility logic unchanged; 11/11 gold cancels pass |
| E8 | get_user_details.py | composite read loop: `reservations_overview` | read-only; adds info only |
| E9 | get_reservation_flight_times.py, search_itineraries_by_price.py | docs: per-flight vs total; placeholder example ids | additive |

## Verify-the-fix (local harness /tmp/ce: tool files exec'd with env_* bound to tau2 AirlineTools on db.json)
- E1: 44 t4 NM1VX1 [HAT001,HAT002] / t3 [HAT401,HAT402] / KC18K6 [HAT003,HAT004] / H8Q05L [HAT005] and 23 t1 K1NW8N flight change → all return the basic-economy Error listing the real flights; 44 gold NM1VX1 [HAT300,HAT208] business → OK. All 20 gold update_reservation_flights in tasks.json (sequential per task) → 0 blocked.
- E2: 4NQLHD with HAT999 → "not an available flight between IAH and SEA"; 10's legit change quote (2010) unaffected.
- E3: NM1VX1 with HAT101/HAT202 → Error; with current flights → user_will_pay 484 (matches env).
- E4: 23 t3 [HAT023, HAT100] round trip → "HAT023 arrives at SFO but HAT100 departs from SEA (a leg is missing)"; 1-leg JFK→ATL for JFK→SEA → "must end at SEA"; gold-like 3-leg 23 booking → OK.
- E5: 20 t4 args (cert 155 + card 100) → booked as cert 250 + card 5 (== gold) with note; 10/10 gold books → "ok" (no notes).
- E7: FDZ0T5 → SUCCESS text + refund -3778; M20IZO still refused.
- E8: overview for aarav_ahmed_6699 shows "M20IZO: … JFK -> MCO | HAT268 JFK->ATL 2024-05-22; HAT010 ATL->MCO 2024-05-22"; sophia_martin_4574 shows all 7 with dates.
- All files: exactly one top-level def named like the file (ast check). SKILL.md empty; primitive_tools untouched.

## Skipped
- 10 t0: cross-session contamination (framework) — no tool edit can fix it.
- KC18K6 upgrade in 44: depends on interpreting "flights ≤ 3h" per flight; only an additive doc hint (E9), no code that decides for the user.
- 8 t4 total_baggages: no safe code predicate (gold has total>0 & nonfree=0 in 20/24/29) → doc only.
- 42 MFRB94 over-cancel: judgment; addressed indirectly by the overview (E8), no guard (would block legit cancels).

## Process
- Serial diagnosis of all 35 trajectories with a compact dumper; no subagents (7 tasks small enough). Reused and extended the iteration-1 harness.

## Preserve
- iteration-1 guards (payment ids, cert limits, DOB autocorrect, cancel predicate) and compute tools.
